title: 卖身契
music: rural Chinese drama underscore, erhu, pipa, low strings, growing tension, mid tempo, instrumental, no vocals
logline: While the village celebrates its 200,000 yuan, Xiaokang finds the contract binds them to work for the developer forever - and the village turns on him.

clips.summary: At {loc}, the villagers celebrate the signed contracts: {cunmin} can't believe the money and {dahua} brags it was all her doing, while {xiaokang} stands apart reading the contract.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: excited chatter and laughter of a crowd, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 二十万！俺这辈子都没见过这么多钱！
cuts.say: 二十万！俺这辈子……都没见过这么多钱！
cuts.act: 兴奋得声音发颤，乐得合不拢嘴，嗓门很大
cuts.delivery: beaming, waving the contract, voice cracking with excitement
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin} centre frame, grinning; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, laughing.
cuts.action: {cunmin} slaps the contract against his palm and laughs.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 这回要不是我牵头，你们谁能多拿这十五万？
cuts.say: 这回要不是我牵头……你们谁能多拿这十五万？
cuts.act: 被众人围着，得意洋洋，拖长了腔调炫耀
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} in the left two-thirds of the frame, flushed with pride; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, nodding.
cuts.action: {dahua} fans herself with the contract and looks around at her admirers.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} standing alone at the edge of the crowd at {loc}, holding {contract}.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} flips the pages of {contract} back and forth, frowning, then freezes, eyes widening at one page.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude, at slow speed.
cuts.end: His eyes are fixed on the page.

clips.summary: {xiaokang}'s inner voice says he found a problem nobody noticed; he pushes into the middle of the crowd and tells them the contract is wrong.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: wind through the cornfields, a dog barking far off. The crowd chatters, then falls silent.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我看了三遍，发现了一个所有人都没注意到的问题。
cuts.say: 我看了三遍……发现了一个，所有人都没注意到的问题。
cuts.act: 低沉的内心独白，紧张，越说越确定
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} looking down at {contract}, sunlight on his face.
cuts.action: His finger stops on a line of the contract.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 大家先别急着高兴，这合同有问题！
cuts.say: 大家先别急着高兴——这合同有问题！
cuts.act: 挤到人群中间，举起合同大声喊，又急又响
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in the middle of the crowd, centre frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, turning toward him.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} scoffs; {xiaokang} explains the contract has no time limit, so they must work for the developer as long as he wants; {cunmin} says he is just jealous.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: wind through the cornfields, a dog barking far off. The crowd mutters.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李家娃子，你又在闹什么？
cuts.say: 李家娃子……你又在闹什么？
cuts.act: 不耐烦，翻白眼，阴阳怪气
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua}, arms folded, centre-left of the frame.
cuts.action: {dahua} rolls her eyes and folds her arms.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 合同上没写期限，他想让你干多久，你就得干多久！
cuts.say: 合同上没写期限！他想让你干多久……你就得干多久！
cuts.act: 急切地解释，指着合同那一页，恳切又着急
cuts.delivery: urgent and pleading, jabbing a finger at the page
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} holding {contract} open toward the crowd, centre-right of the frame.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} stabs his finger at a paragraph of {contract}.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 我看他就是眼红！自己选错了！
cuts.say: 我看他就是眼红！自己选错了！
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin} in the right two-thirds of the frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, nodding.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} accuses {xiaokang} and his father of wanting to ruin the village; he stands pale and shaking.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: wind through the cornfields, a dog barking far off. The crowd's muttering grows louder.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 还是说，你和你爸都想着坏我们一个村的人？
cuts.say: 还是说……你和你爸，都想着坏我们一个村的人？
cuts.act: 双手抱胸，冷冷地逼问，一字一顿
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {dahua} faces the camera in the left third, arms folded.
cuts.action: {dahua} leans in, arms folded, staring him down.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} centre frame, the hostile crowd blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang}'s face drains of colour; his lips tremble and he grips {contract} until it crumples.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.

clips.summary: Old {erdaye} limps up on his cane and pats {xiaokang}; when Xiaokang asks if even he doubts him, the old man says nothing is scarier than corn rotting in the field.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: wind through the cornfields, a dog barking far off. The crowd goes quiet; a cane taps on the dirt.

cuts.composition: Medium shot at {loc}: {erdaye} limps in from the left on his cane toward {xiaokang}, who stands in the right third.
cuts.action: {erdaye} reaches {xiaokang} and pats his arm gently.
cuts.sound: A cane taps on the dirt.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.act: 声音哽住，委屈又难以置信，说不下去
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in the right two-thirds of the frame, eyes glistening.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} looks at the old man, swallowing hard.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.line: 没有什么事，比玉米烂在地里一年没收成更吓人了。
cuts.say: 小康啊……没有什么事，比玉米烂在地里、一年都没收成，更吓人了。
cuts.act: 慢慢地、语重心长，苍老的声音里带着心疼
cuts.delivery: slow and sorrowful, shaking his head
cuts.composition: Close-up of {erdaye} in the left two-thirds of the frame, the cornfields soft behind him.
cuts.action: {erdaye} shakes his head slowly, eyes full of pity.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {erdaye} sends {xiaokang} home to think it over; Xiaokang grips the contract, alone against the village.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: wind through the cornfields, a dog barking far off.

cuts.speaker: erdaye
cuts.action: {erdaye} pats Xiaokang's hand and turns away.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in three-quarter profile, the villagers drifting away behind him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} watches the old man go, then looks down at {contract}; his jaw sets.
cuts.camera: Static camera, slow push in, with small amplitude.
